playbooks.summary: Windows native/game reverse workflow with frozen target identity, architecture-aware tooling, isolated mutation paths, rollback, and evidence currentness.

gates.title: Classify the target and requested deliverable
gates.pass_criterion: Exact target file/process/resource type, user goal, and mutation vs observation boundary are explicit.

gates.title: Freeze environment truth
gates.pass_criterion: Target SHA/process identity plus required tool availability and architecture route are current; no guessed tool path.

gates.title: Establish a control copy/session
gates.pass_criterion: A read-only baseline or isolated copy/session exists before any patch, hook, or debugger-side mutation.

gates.title: Prove effect and recovery
gates.pass_criterion: The smallest intended effect is verified against the current target and rollback/cleanup is independently checked.

done: Evidence binds the exact target identity and current revision/process instance.
No unrelated debugger/Ghidra/browser session was hijacked.
Any mutation has an explicit operation identity and verified rollback or immutable copy output.
Findings distinguish observed, inferred, and runtime-verified conclusions.
Temporary processes, ports, and task-owned resources are released.

playbooks.summary: Offline pinned JADX recovery preserves original DEX observations, parsed identities, explicit overloads, static-only references and lifecycle evidence.

gates.title: Bind artifact and runtime
gates.pass_criterion: Original APK/DEX SHA, pinned engine, bridge/java/compiler identities and supported native process-tree profile are recorded; file presence does not prove an actual worker run.

gates.title: Preserve original bytes and producer identity
gates.pass_criterion: DEX method index/descriptor/raw bytes and structural CFG stay separate from derived Java/smali and producer-local overload ordinals; wide literals retain exact decimal text.

gates.title: Recover exact selected observations
gates.pass_criterion: Ambiguous methods require an explicit ordinal, native code absence and static initializer fallback are retained; byte pages bind artifact/result SHA and static references do not claim runtime calls or JNI bindings.

gates.title: Close and review
gates.pass_criterion: The original backend owner confirms cleanup before private workspace removal; uncertain startup cleanup retains evidence and fails. Canonical Case/Review/Report/Journal record limits and original input currentness.

done: Exact immutable artifact/runtime identities are retained.
Actual producer results and original DEX bytes are distinguished.
Failure/cancellation cleanup is verified and unresolved scope remains explicit.
Canonical research evidence is reviewed; no target execution, installation or device proof is inferred.

playbooks.summary: Offline Android research binds APK/member hashes, inspects manifest/resource/DEX declarations with built-in readers, and records reviewed static evidence without requiring a device.

gates.title: Bind the original package
gates.pass_criterion: Original APK/DEX and selected member SHA256, package shape and split-set limitations are recorded; all pages and build-local indices use the same original hash.

gates.title: Inspect admitted declarations
gates.pass_criterion: Components, manifest attributes, resource configurations and DEX definitions/references are distinguished; unsupported formats and unresolved effective values are reported.

gates.title: Correlate static evidence
gates.pass_criterion: Every finding links exact immutable member results and byte ranges; declared permissions/native methods/resource IDs do not imply runtime binding, reachability, signer validity or device behavior.

gates.title: Review and preserve the research
gates.pass_criterion: Canonical Case evidence, finding, path, strict Review, report and Journal preserve the conclusion and explicit runtime gaps; the input remains unchanged and no target is executed.

done: Source and selected member hashes are pinned and input currentness is checked.
Built-in offline readers require no ADB, Frida, APK installation or device session.
DEX references, definitions and native declarations remain separate observations.
Resource configurations, typed raw values and manifest declarations retain their evidence limits.
Reviewed Case/report/Journal records preserve reproducible static evidence and unresolved runtime work.

playbooks.summary: Android APK/DEX/native/runtime workflow that classifies delivery form, device truth, signing/install baseline, smallest patch layer, and real-device verification before calling work complete.

gates.title: Classify APK shape and deliverable
gates.pass_criterion: Single/split APK, Java/Kotlin vs native/Flutter, packed state, and desired output form are identified before patching.

gates.title: Freeze device and tool truth
gates.pass_criterion: ADB authorization, device/API/ABI/root state, package identity, signatures, and required tool paths/versions are recorded.

gates.title: Prove an untouched control build
gates.pass_criterion: Original artifact can be decoded/installed/launched or the exact pre-existing failure is recorded before modifications.

gates.title: Apply the smallest viable layer and verify
gates.pass_criterion: Patch/hook/repack uses the narrowest layer and is validated on the intended device/runtime including signing/network-sensitive paths.

done: Artifact and device/package identities are pinned and reproducible.
Static success is not treated as runtime success; launch and changed feature are independently verified when runtime is in scope.
Signing/split-APK/native ABI consequences are recorded.
A failed route after two same-shape attempts is reclassified instead of parameter-tweaked indefinitely.
Evidence states whether a claim is measured, inferred, blocked, or not exercised.

playbooks.summary: Browser/JavaScript/WASM reverse workflow using an isolated profile, source/network/runtime evidence, signature-chain tracing, and local equivalence checks without touching the daily browser session.

gates.title: Isolate target browser state
gates.pass_criterion: Dedicated profile/session, target origin, task scope, and read-only vs active instrumentation boundary are explicit.

gates.title: Freeze source and network truth
gates.pass_criterion: Loaded scripts/chunks/source maps/WASM and the relevant request/response samples are captured with stable identities where obtainable.

gates.title: Locate the runtime chain before rebuilding
gates.pass_criterion: The producing function/call path and required browser state are observed before creating a Node/local reproduction.

gates.title: Prove local/runtime equivalence
gates.pass_criterion: Rebuilt or instrumented logic reproduces the same outputs for bounded fixtures, or the missing environment dependency is explicitly identified.

done: Daily browser profile and unrelated sessions remain untouched.
Evidence links network values to the exact runtime producer or explicitly states the unresolved gap.
Source-map/minified/generated code provenance is preserved.
Local rebuild declares every patched environment dependency and has bounded equivalence fixtures.
WASM/native boundaries are not mislabeled as ordinary JavaScript.

playbooks.summary: Evidence-first malware workflow from immutable sample identity through static/dynamic analysis, config/C2, IOC/TTP, detections, remediation and retest.

gates.title: Freeze sample identity and scope
gates.pass_criterion: Sample SHA/provenance, Case, Engagement scope, requested deliverable and observation-vs-execution boundary are explicit.

gates.title: Establish tool and lab truth
gates.pass_criterion: Required tool identities are current and any execution environment is task-owned, isolated, and has an explicit network mode.

gates.title: Build evidence-backed behavior hypotheses
gates.pass_criterion: Static claims, runtime observations, configuration/C2 and IOC/TTP mappings remain provenance-linked and hypotheses retain conflicting evidence/retractions.

gates.title: Validate detections and cleanup
gates.pass_criterion: Detection candidates have syntax/schema plus positive/negative fixture evidence, applicable retest is recorded, and lab cleanup is verified.

done: Sample identity and provenance are frozen.
Static inference is not mislabeled as runtime behavior.
IOC/TTP/Findings are evidence-linked.
Validated detections have positive and negative fixtures plus revision.
Task-owned lab state and network simulation are cleaned or reset.

playbooks.summary: Detection-engineering workflow that binds evidence and telemetry requirements to versioned rules, fixture validation, false-positive notes, coverage and retest.

gates.title: Bind behavior to evidence
gates.pass_criterion: The Finding/TTP or behavior hypothesis and supporting Evidence are identified before rule authoring.

gates.title: Freeze telemetry contract
gates.pass_criterion: Required telemetry source, fields, normalization assumptions and availability are explicit.

gates.title: Validate rule mechanics
gates.pass_criterion: Rule syntax/schema and revision are recorded with positive and negative fixtures and expected outcomes.

gates.title: Measure coverage and retest
gates.pass_criterion: False positives, coverage gaps, deployment assumptions and evidence-backed retest are recorded.

done: Detection is a first-class Case artifact.
Raw telemetry evidence remains preserved.
validated=true is impossible without evidence and positive/negative fixtures.
Coverage gaps remain explicit.
Rule revision and retest are recorded.

playbooks.summary: Purple validation from ATT&CK technique and scoped emulation Job through telemetry, detection gap, mitigation/countermeasure and retest evidence.

gates.title: Select technique and expected telemetry
gates.pass_criterion: ATT&CK technique/behavior hypothesis and expected telemetry are explicit and evidence-backed.

gates.title: Authorize the effect
gates.pass_criterion: Engagement/Scope allows the exact target/action and a Generic Job with operation_id is prepared before emulation.

gates.title: Capture telemetry and classify the gap
gates.pass_criterion: Actual telemetry and Detection revision are captured; miss causes distinguish collection, normalization, logic, deployment and expected non-coverage.

gates.title: Mitigate and retest
gates.pass_criterion: Mitigation/countermeasure is linked to the technique/control and a new evidence revision proves the retest result.

done: Emulation stayed inside Engagement scope.
Effectful action has a durable Job receipt.
Uncertain effect was not auto-replayed.
Telemetry and detection result are evidence-backed.
Mitigation and retest close the TTP-to-control loop.

playbooks.summary: Linux ELF/native workflow with frozen ELF/build identity, static-first analysis, core-dump provenance and explicit debugger/emulation effect boundaries.

gates.title: Freeze ELF identity and architecture
gates.pass_criterion: Exact ELF SHA, class/data/machine/type/entry and GNU build-id when present are recorded before analysis.

gates.title: Establish tool/runtime truth
gates.pass_criterion: Ghidra/radare2/GDB/LLDB/rr availability and architecture compatibility are current; no guessed tool path.

gates.title: Separate static proof from runtime proof
gates.pass_criterion: Symbols/xrefs/core artifacts remain observations; debugger or trace execution is represented as an authorized Job when used.

gates.title: Close evidence and cleanup
gates.pass_criterion: Findings link exact ELF/core evidence and any task-owned debugger/runtime resources are released.

done: ELF identity and provenance are pinned.
Static conclusions are not called runtime proof.
Any runtime execution has an Engagement/Job boundary.
Architecture/tool mismatch is explicit.
Temporary runtime state is cleaned.

playbooks.summary: Vulnerability workflow from surface/harness through fuzz/repro, crash fingerprint, minimization, root cause, mitigation and regression evidence.

gates.title: Freeze target, harness and corpus
gates.pass_criterion: Target identity, harness identity, corpus scope, engine/sanitizers and execution boundary are explicit.

gates.title: Produce reproducible crash evidence
gates.pass_criterion: Crash input identity plus module/exception/fault instruction/normalized stack fingerprint are durable and duplicates are grouped.

gates.title: Establish root cause without overclaiming
gates.pass_criterion: Root cause and security primitive remain hypotheses/findings with evidence; exploitability is not inferred from a crash alone.

gates.title: Mitigate and regress
gates.pass_criterion: Patch/mitigation is linked to the Finding and minimized fixture plus negative regression evidence is recorded.

done: Fuzz execution is explicitly authorized and isolated.
Crash dedupe uses structural fingerprints, not exception code alone.
Minimized inputs keep hashes/provenance.
Candidate exploitability is not called validated without evidence.
Regression/retest is recorded.

playbooks.summary: DFIR workflow that preserves raw evidence identities and builds provenance-linked normalized timelines without replacing source artifacts.

gates.title: Freeze forensic evidence
gates.pass_criterion: Each memory/disk/event/registry/network artifact has immutable identity and acquisition provenance before parsing.

gates.title: Select parser by artifact truth
gates.pass_criterion: Native/adapted parser and tool identity are explicit; unsupported formats are not guessed.

gates.title: Normalize without erasing provenance
gates.pass_criterion: Timeline/process/network facts link source artifact SHA and source record/line while raw evidence remains unchanged.

gates.title: Build incident findings
gates.pass_criterion: Suspicious chains, persistence and user/session/network correlations are evidence-linked and uncertainty remains visible.

done: Raw evidence remains immutable.
Normalized events retain source provenance.
Bad/unparsed records are counted, not silently dropped.
Timeline is deterministically ordered/deduplicated.
Findings reference raw evidence.

playbooks.summary: Protocol reverse workflow from PCAP/raw messages to candidate framing/fields/state model/parser and round-trip validation.

gates.title: Freeze message corpus
gates.pass_criterion: Raw PCAP/byte/message identities and direction/session metadata are preserved before inference.

gates.title: Infer candidates conservatively
gates.pass_criterion: Stable/variable offsets, endian/length/checksum candidates are marked candidate and tied to the sample set.

gates.title: Validate framing and semantics
gates.pass_criterion: Candidate parser/serializer survives positive fixtures and round-trip tests before being promoted.

gates.title: Publish reproducible schema
gates.pass_criterion: Frame definition/state relationships and generated parser/dissector artifacts pin source corpus/revision.

done: Raw bytes remain evidence.
Candidate fields are not labeled validated without fixtures.
Round-trip validation is explicit.
Encryption/compression unknowns remain hypotheses.
Generated schema pins corpus identity.

gates.title: Freeze repository and scan boundary

gates.title: Inventory manifests and tool truth
gates.pass_criterion: Language/dependency/SBOM inputs plus SAST/SCA tool identities are recorded; generated folders are intentionally scoped.

gates.title: Validate findings
gates.pass_criterion: Scanner output is normalized into Case Evidence/Finding and candidate secrets remain fingerprinted/redacted until reviewed.

gates.title: Remediate and retest
gates.pass_criterion: Source/dependency remediation maps to the original finding and retest/SARIF revision proves current status.

done: Repository scan is bounded and reproducible.
Secrets are never emitted in plaintext by inventory output.
Third-party stdout is not a final Finding.
SBOM/dependency provenance is preserved.
Retest links the remediated revision.
